page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. No marginal notes. Running head at the top with the page number at the top left. Catchword at the lower right of the text block.

main_text.p: tias ita statim exerceri voluerit, atque eo prorsus modo quo vitiosi affectus optimè possint extirpari, & in eadem demum studia & virtutes Regias præparari, quibus, eorum in quos Te Deus constituerit, & amorem maximè potes conciliare & saluti consulere.
A Deo auspicari te quàm maximè cupio, & cum Deo finire, qui est Rex Regum, & Supremus Regnorum dispensator, qui dejicit alios, alios extollit.
Verus Principis honos in promovenda Dei Gloria, in tuenda vera Religione & Ecclesiæ Bono consistit, tum Potestatem Civilem ea Iustitiâ & Honore administrando qui Bono Publico maximè conducat.
Florentem te satis præstabit Pietas, à miseria saltem immunem custodiet: quamquam levi admodum damno afficitur, qui in salutem Animæ perdit omnia.

Ad hoc Centrum veræ fœlicitatis direxit Deus suâ misericordia, & (ut spero) etiam directurus est nigras illas omnes ærumnarum lineas super Me eo fine productas ut per has ad se propius adduceret. Tu jam Calicem [?] libâsti, quem ego large hausi, quod ut Dei Pharmacum accipio, quod deest suavitatis salubritate com-pensans.

Id vero tibi expeto potissimùm, (quod & spero jam factum) ut in Religione firmus radiceris, quam ego semper existimavi in Ecclesia Anglicana (cujus Tu alumnus es) optimè fuisse institutam, opto verò ut Ratione &

page.notes: Fragment at the top of the page: the first word "tias" continues from the previous page. "Calicem" is doubtful (the first letters are unclear). "quibus" is read from a worn word. "com-pensans" is split at the line end; the hyphen is taken as printed. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The running head is Greek: ΕΙΚΩΝ ΒΑΣΙΛΙΚΗ. The catchword "Iudicio" is set at the lower right. The dark strip on the left and right edges is the binding and the neighbouring page, not text.
